diagnosis: The facility automation namespace allows connected sockets to issue actuator commands (e.g. door lock overrides and alarm disabling) across a Redis cluster. The middleware verifies token validity but never checks if the user is authorized to control the buildingId in socket.nsp.name, allowing an attacker to unlock physical doors or disrupt security systems of arbitrary facilities.

Host: iot.facilities.internal:4007

Authorization: Bearer <contractor_token>
